checkpoints.change: Prepare recorded-luma and detector-package candidates through the immutable retained reader while capture owns the writer.

behavior: Preparation shares one immutable source snapshot, cumulative retained-read allowance and final metadata/custody validation. No proposal text or JSON export is released on failed final checks.

Read byte/object flags now apply to prepare, remain bounded, and are rejected for publication. The external report keeps its separate existing max-report-bytes bound.
